Synthetic. `v1-retrospective-mock-rekor.pub` is the public key of the local mock Rekor v1 log (test/helpers/mock-rekor.ts) that logged the synthetic v1 fixture `audits/v1-retrospective-2026-q3` on 2026-11-03. It is the verifier's own copy, kept outside the audit repo: `test/v1-compat.test.ts` passes it as `verify --log-key`, as a verifier would pass a log key obtained from the log's operator. The copy inside the audit repo (`rekor.pub`, named by its `.pr-rla.yml`) is never trusted by verify or status.
